SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderTotal, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_fee), 0) AS amountTotal, IFNULL(SUM(o.refund_fee), 0) AS refundAmountTotal FROM gb_order_info o WHERE o.leader_id = #{leaderId} AND o.pay_time > 0 AND o.status <> 6 AND o.add_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, IFNULL(o.pay_fee, 0) AS amountTotal, IFNULL(o.refund_fee, 0) AS refundAmountTotal FROM gb_order_info o WHERE o.leader_id = #{leaderId} AND o.pay_time > 0 AND o.status <> 6 AND o.add_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY o.add_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, MAX(g.goods_name) AS goodsName, IFNULL(SUM(g.goods_price * g.goods_num), 0) AS amountTotal, IFNULL(SUM(g.goods_price * (IFNULL(g.refund_num, 0) + IFNULL(g.refund_goods_num, 0))), 0) AS refundAmountTotal FROM gb_order_goods_info g JOIN gb_order_info o ON g.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.leader_id = #{leaderId} AND o.pay_time > 0 AND o.status <> 6 AND o.add_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY g.goods_id ORDER BY amountTotal DESC, g.goods_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.goods_id) FROM gb_order_goods_info g JOIN gb_order_info o ON g.order_no = o.order_no WHERE o.leader_id = #{leaderId} AND o.pay_time > 0 AND o.status <> 6 AND o.add_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
